title: ConstructionDef
description:
A construction definition from JSON type `"construction"`.

Defines a construction or deconstruction activity that the player can perform to modify the world.

abstract_.description: Abstract flag — if true, this definition is a template.

byproducts.description: Items produced as byproducts. Can be a string (deconstruction result set), a map, or an array of byproduct objects.

components.description: Components required as nested arrays. e.g. [[["nail", 16, "LIST"]], [["2x4", 4]]]

copy_from.description: Base definition id to copy fields from.

dark_craftable.description: Whether this can be crafted in the dark.

do_turn_special.description: Special action to perform each turn during construction. Can be a string or an object.

group.description: Group this construction belongs to (for UI grouping).

on_display.description: Whether this construction is displayed in the menu.

post_flags.description: Post-construction flags to apply to the tile. Can be a string or an array of strings.

post_furniture.description: Post-construction furniture to place. Can be a string or an object.

post_special.description: Post-construction special action (e.g. "done_dig_grave"). Can be a string or an object.

post_terrain.description: Post-construction terrain to place. Can be a string or an object.

pre_flags.description: Pre-construction flags (any of these flags must be present on the tile). Can be a string, an array of strings, or a map with flag options.

pre_furniture.description: Pre-construction furniture requirement. Can be a string or an object.

pre_special.description: Pre-construction special check (e.g. "check_empty"). Can be a string or an array of strings.

pre_terrain.description: Pre-construction terrain requirement. Can be a string or an object.

qualities.description: Tools required as nested arrays. e.g. [[{"id": "HAMMER", "level": 2}], [{"id": "SAW_M", "level": 1}]] Can also be a flat array of tool objects.

required_skills.description: Required skills as pairs of [skill_id, level]. e.g. [["fabrication", 3]].

skill.description: Primary skill for this construction (alternative to required_skills).

time.description: Time required to complete the construction (e.g. "60 m", "5 m").

using.description: Item groups/recipes to use (for pre-defined tool/component sets). e.g. [["wood_removal_standard", 1]]
